scope: PRs related to 64-bit Intel Macs; pre-T1, T1 and T2. T2-specific implementation deferred.
boundary: Local agent planning only. No upstream PRs, comments, approvals, Basecamp updates, package installs or hardware changes. Existing user review decisions are untouched.
method: Re-screened 158 discovery candidates using explicit 64-bit Intel scope (discovery-v2).
Fetched paginated file lists, issue comments, reviews and inline comments for all 163 comparison PRs; no collection errors.

Jev compared 74 families (group-plan-v1). Full local source snapshots are retained; model inputs have explicit per-body, discussion and patch bounds. Two large families were retried with reduced input budgets.
Agent inspected priority patches and key discussions, checked current package contents, and ran pure keyboard-model probes. Other families remain queued, not silently approved.
limitations: This is a dated snapshot, not a claim of exhaustive GitHub discovery. New discovery used keyword candidates among records updated since September 15; older unindexed and keyword-missing records may be absent.
All source discussions were collected, but not every discussion or complete file blob was manually reviewed. Missing/truncated API patches are noted in the captured sources.
Jev confidence is not measured correctness, hardware readiness or maintainer acceptance. Contradictory model lead/structure answers remain visible.
Reported hardware results are attributed source reports. No new driver, install, reboot, suspend, firmware or physical-device validation was performed.
The original 222-record dashboard remains intact. Additional candidates and agent plans live in this separate planning view.
